title: Rams don’t feel pressure to draft a quarterback in April

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Rams don’t feel pressure to draft a quarterback in April
sources.description: The Los Angeles Rams know that eventually they must confront a reality every NFL team faces: replacing a franchise quarterback. For now, that quarterback remains Matthew Stafford, who helped deliver a championship during Super Bowl LVI and continues to lead the offense for head coach Sean McVay.
